decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 27th June 2005, the erection of a rear roof extension incorporating 3 front roof windows, one side roof window, railings to rear and conversion from hip-to-gable having a total volume of 47.88m3 was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

Condition : 2 - If work commences on any other extension (including the part two storey, part single storey side extension, referenced 00132/43/P2, approved on 30 September 2003) before the loft extension subject to this decision is completed, this will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the loft extension.  As a result the owner may be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension incorporating 3 front roof windows, one side roof window, railings to rear and conversion from hip to gable
